title: Outlet
summary: Render the active flat route and optionally provide context to its descendants.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Accepts context and optional children. When children is null or undefined, Outlet renders Routes with its default loading fallback. An explicit child replaces that route rendering.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns an Outlet context provider around its children or Routes. A missing or null context inherits the nearest ancestor Outlet context.

sections.title: Root shell
sections.body: Use Outlet from a root module to place the active page inside a persistent shell. Keep route components in their own files.

sections.title: Flat routing
sections.body: Outlet does not create a hierarchy of nested route records. It renders the active flat match. Context can be read with useOutletContext<T>; provide and share that type yourself because it cannot be inferred across component boundaries.
